create_seq2seq_training_args: create a GaudiSeq2SeqTrainingArguments instance to configure seq2seq model training on Habana Gaudi
configure_predict_with_generate: set predict_with_generate to calculate ROUGE and BLEU metrics during evaluation
set_generation_max_length: set generation_max_length to control output sequence length during evaluation loops
set_generation_num_beams: set generation_num_beams to control beam search width during evaluation loops
serialize_training_args_to_dict: call to_dict on GaudiSeq2SeqTrainingArguments to serialize it including GaudiGenerationConfig as a dictionary
